MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

2. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 49
   C. 43
   D. 31

5. Solve for x: x + 9 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 12

6. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 41
   C. 40
   D. 3

7. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 17
   C. 8
   D. 0

8. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 10

2. A — 27 cm³

3. B — 144
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

4. A — 41
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 40²
3. c² = 81 + 1600
4. c² = 1681
5. c = 41
Final Answer: 41 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

Working:

2. Substitute values: x = 20 − 9
3. x = 11
Final Answer: x = 11
